title: Code-tidying team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/code-tidying.yaml, the team layer of the code-tidying plugin's settings, and its personal overlay code-tidying.local.yaml. A key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name; the overlay wins over the team file. Keys and resolution: the Settings section of skills/remove-comments/SKILL.md.

comment_posture.description: Which comments /code-tidying:remove-comments keeps. auto: explanatory, or necessary in a pull-request pipeline run. none: only machine-read directives, license headers, TODO(#issue) markers, paired records and public-API doc comments stay. necessary: also verified outside-constraint comments. explanatory: every comment that passes the earn-its-keep test.

comment_edit_scope.description: On the uncommitted and branch scope rungs, diff triages only comments on the lines the change adds; files triages every comment in each changed file.

encode_constraints_unattended.description: Whether an unattended remove-comments run may encode a constraint comment as a test, assertion or lint rule without asking. Off: the encoding is offered in the report.

class_c_max_lines.description: Lines a kept comment may run before remove-comments rewrites it terser.

apply_local_renames.description: Whether a function-local rename certified RENAME-ONLY applies without a test net.
